4248 of 2024 Learned Counsel appearing on behalf of the opposite party submits that they want to withdraw the proceeding initiated against the petitioner and to that extent they have filed one application before the Trial Court which is pending for disposal.
In such circumstances, learned Trial Court will be at liberty to dispose of the complainant's prayer for withdrawal at the earliest.
Matter be listed four weeks hence.
Parties to act on a server copy of this order duly collected from the official website of the Hon'ble High Court, Calcutta.

( Dr. Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J. )
